findings: The code fits the standing decisions in brain/project.md. There is one module per asset, with blender/build_all.py as the single entry point. render_lineup.py reuses build_all.ASSETS. Only primitives and procedural materials are used. The player is six named parts. Tests parse the glb files without Blender. There is no importer or image loader anywhere in blender/.

The approved contract was edited inside the feature change. .openspec/specs/asset-factory/spec.md is modified in the working tree. Its status changed from 'approved for build' to 'revised, awaiting approval'. The character look line and the render_lineup.py import clause were also rewritten. The builder and reviewer stations do not own the spec, so the code is now built against a spec that is no longer approved. Either re-approve the revised spec at the spec-writer stage or the human gate, or revert the edit and fit the code to the approved text.
package.json changes the test script from 'node --test tests/' to 'node --test "tests/**/*.test.js"'. The change is reasonable, but the spec and work order do not mention it. Record it.

The project has no brain/decisions directory. The only decision file is .anvil-factory/brain/decisions/0001-composable-stations.md, which concerns ANVIL stations and does not apply to the asset code. The review used the standing decisions in brain/project.md instead. I did not run Blender 4.5.15 in this station.
